title: Relational Database Keys: Primary Keys vs. Foreign Keys
realWorldScenario: During an engineering onboarding session, an associate engineer asks why foreign keys are defined in the schema instead of managing relations purely in application code.
questionStatement: Explain the core differences between a Primary Key and a Foreign Key. What database guarantees do they enforce, and what is Referential Integrity?
expectedConcepts: Primary Key uniqueness and NOT NULL constraint
hints: Contrast uniqueness within a table versus links across tables.
Explain what happens if someone tries to delete a parent record that has children.
